      <div class="page-content">
        <!-- ══ VENUE ══ -->
        <h2 id="venue">Conference Venue</h2>
        <div class="venue-placeholder">
          <div>
            <i
              class="fa fa-building"
              style="
                font-size: 52px;
                display: block;
                margin-bottom: 12px;
                opacity: 0.85;
              "
            ></i>
            GIMPA<br />
            <span style="font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.8">Accra, Ghana</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 will be held at <strong>GIMPA</strong> (Ghana
          Institute of Management and Public Administration), a premier
          conference venue in Accra, Ghana, featuring state-of-the-art
          facilities, multiple conference halls, exhibition spaces, and modern
          technology infrastructure.
        </p>
        <ul>
          <li><strong>Venue:</strong> Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA), Greenhill Campus</li>
          <li><strong>Address:</strong> Forest Road, Greenhill, P.O. Box AH 50, Achimota, Accra, Ghana</li>
          <li><strong>GPS:</strong> 5.6365285, -0.2024102 (plus code JQPX+CP, Accra)</li>
          <li><strong>Telephone:</strong> <a href="tel:+233302404664">+233 30 240 4664</a> / <a href="tel:+233302908076">+233 30 290 8076</a></li>
          <li><strong>Email:</strong> <a href="mailto:info@gimpa.edu.gh">info@gimpa.edu.gh</a></li>
          <li><strong>Website:</strong> <a href="https://gimpa.edu.gh/locations/gimpa/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">gimpa.edu.gh</a></li>
          <li><strong>Map:</strong> <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=5.6365285&amp;mlon=-0.2024102#map=17/5.6365285/-0.2024102" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open venue map</a></li>
        </ul>

        <!-- ══ ACCOMMODATION ══ -->
        <h2 id="accommodation" style="margin-top: 36px">Accommodation</h2>

        <div class="accommodation-note">
          <strong>Accommodation disclaimer:</strong> No official conference
          room block, negotiated rate, booking deadline or hotel cancellation
          condition has yet been approved. The properties listed below are
          provided only as independent nearby options; listing does not imply
          endorsement by IEEE, IEEE Region 8, or the organizers. Delegates are
          responsible for checking current rates, accessibility, taxes,
          availability and cancellation terms directly with the property. A range of accommodation options
          are available near GIMPA in Accra, from luxury hotels to
          budget-friendly guesthouses. The options below are selected for their
          proximity to the conference venue. We recommend booking early, as
          availability may be limited during the conference dates (September
          23–25, 2027).
        </div>

        <!-- ══ TRAVEL ══ -->
        <h2 id="travel" style="margin-top: 40px">Getting There</h2>
        <h3>By Air</h3>
        <p>
          Accra is served by
          <strong>Kotoka International Airport (ACC)</strong>, which offers
          direct flights to major African cities and international hubs
          including Lagos, Johannesburg, Nairobi, London, Amsterdam, and other
          international destinations.
        </p>
        <h3>From the Airport</h3>
        <p>
          The airport is approximately 5 km from GIMPA. Taxis and ride-sharing
          services (including Uber and Bolt) are readily available. The journey
          typically takes 15–20 minutes depending on traffic.
        </p>

        <h2 id="visa" style="margin-top: 40px">Visa &amp; Entry Information</h2>
        <p>
          Entry requirements depend on nationality and passport type. Many
          travellers require a visa before travel, while ECOWAS nationals and
          certain other travellers may qualify for an exemption. A visa does
          not by itself guarantee admission at the border. Travellers should
          verify passport validity, visa or exemption status, yellow-fever
          vaccination requirements and any current health or transit rules with
          the <a href="https://gis.gov.gh/visas/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ghana Immigration Service</a>
          and the nearest Ghanaian embassy or high commission before booking.
        </p>
        <p>
          Conference invitation letters, when available, support an application
          but do not guarantee a visa. Immigration rules can change, and the
          organizers and IEEE cannot provide legal or immigration advice or
          reimburse costs arising from a visa refusal or delayed application.
        </p>

        <!-- ══ ABOUT ACCRA ══ -->
        <h2 id="accra" style="margin-top: 40px">About Accra</h2>
        <p>
          Accra, the capital and largest city of Ghana, is a vibrant coastal
          city known for its rich cultural heritage, friendly atmosphere, and
          rapidly growing technology and innovation ecosystems. As one of West
          Africa's most developed cities, Accra offers a unique blend of modern
          facilities and authentic African culture.
        </p>
        <p>
          Ghana is a leader in technology and innovation on the African
          continent, hosting major tech companies, startups, and research
          institutions. The country's commitment to ICT development and its
          position in West Africa makes Accra a fitting host for the 18th
          edition of IEEE AFRICON.
        </p>
        <p>
          Visitors can explore the Cape Coast Castle, the vibrant Makola Market,
          the Osu Castle, Labadi Beach, and the nearby Kakum National Park, all
          within reach of Accra.
        </p>
